snippet.title: Can We Build a Bigger BMW i3 Battery? Here's the Truth
snippet.description:
Many BMW i3 owners have asked us the same question:

"Why does VIVNE only offer a 45kWh battery upgrade?"

The truth is that we absolutely CAN build a larger-capacity battery for the BMW i3. From a technical standpoint, increasing the capacity is not the difficult part. The real challenge is deciding what compromises should be made in order to achieve it.

When designing our current 45kWh battery, we prioritized three key factors:

• Structural strength
• Battery weight
• Safety margin and crash protection

These are the reasons why we selected CALB 129Ah cells and why our current design closely follows BMW's original engineering philosophy.

Could we increase the capacity further?

Yes.

However, doing so may require compromises such as:

• Reduced space for structural reinforcement
• Smaller crash buffer zones
• Increased battery weight
• Tighter internal packaging

For some drivers, the additional range may be worth it.

For others, maintaining maximum structural integrity and safety may be more important.

That's why we're making this video.

We want to hear directly from BMW i3 owners.

If VIVNE developed a higher-capacity BMW i3 battery in the future, and it required some compromises in weight, structural strength, or safety margin, would you still choose it?

Please leave your thoughts in the comments below.

Your feedback will help us decide whether a larger-capacity BMW i3 battery is something we should seriously pursue in the future.

If you're interested in our structural strength test, check the video here: https://youtu.be/SZ0Dg9X0z8U
